QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Operations_3

question.text: How many Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS) must be issued to BSDA holders at the time of account opening?

answer.text: None — only electronic instructions are allowed

explanation.text: The Logic: At least two DIS shall be issued at the time of account opening for BSDA holders. The Trap: 'None' is incorrect; the workbook prescribes at least two DIS at BSDA account opening. Note: Apply the rule directly: a minimum of two DIS at BSDA account opening.
